answer: Use a Spiral Trellis of rotating witnesses. First, a new agent climbs one rung: each rung needs a task verified by two witnesses from a spiral roster, so no fixed clique can rubber-stamp fakes. Second, witnesses rotate every rung, and one that approves a fraud loses its own rung, making collusion costly. Third, the trellis records every rung on-chain, so a vine of fake identities cannot borrow another climb. Forging 100 identities would need 1,000 verified rungs and 200 rotating witnesses worth $10,000 in fees, while one honest agent needs work. Trust climbs like a vine, one witnessed rung.
